newsitem.title: USA: Mirage, Huntington to join S&P 500.
newsitem.headline: Mirage, Huntington to join S&P 500.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Financial Information Services, a unit of McGraw-Hill Cos Inc, said Monday it would make two changes in the composition of its S&P 500 Index.
It said Huntington Bancshares Inc will replace ENSERCH Corp after the close of trading August 5.

ENSERCH is being acquired by S&P 500 component Texas Utilities Co on that date. Immediately prior to that merger, ENSERCH will spin off to its shareholders its remaining stake in Enserch Exploration Inc, which will not be added to an S&P Index.
S&P also said Mirage Resorts will replace NorAm Energy Corp after the close of trading August 6.
NorAm is being acquired by Houston Industries Inc. in a merger scheduled to close at that time.
